correctness.rationale: Use Adam-Day et al structural theorem for finite PL_2 rooted frames: height<=2, depth-one points have at most two strict successors, strict upset of root connected. Exactly-height-two frames therefore correspond bijectively to connected bipartite incidence systems with each depth-one labeled point incident with one or two labeled tops. For a partition π of top set, permissible choices per depth-one label are t+sum_B choose(|B|,2); Möbius inversion coefficient (-1)^(|π|-1)(|π|-1)! gives N_(t,e). Two-sort exponential formula log sum exp(choose(t+1,2)y)x^t/t! counts connected systems; choose top labels for global R_m. Independently enumerated 20 small (t,e) grids and matched partition lattice counts. Finite verification supplemental to combinatorial bijection.
